agent_explanation: Emergency preempt at t=147 immediately forces NS green at step 148 while EW was still yellow at step 147. The controller skips the all-red phase entirely, so all_red_seconds (1 s) is not observed: approach 0 (and 2) turn green after 0 s of all-red. This also truncates EW yellow to 1 s, violating yellow_duration as secondary evidence. Removing the emergency event eliminates the violation.
